# NexDocs

> AI-powered business document generator for South African businesses. Generates contracts, quotes, HR letters, and legal forms in seconds.

NexDocs is built by Cossa Nexus Holdings for South African SMEs. It offers a 10-day free trial, then R99/month via PayFast. Features include AI document generation across six company profiles, PDF export, and a Gauteng business lead finder.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, pricing, and the six company document categories.
- [Sign in / Register](/auth): Create an account or sign in to start the 10-day free trial.
